(2) As the scene continues, the boy raises more fingers to count, showing two then three fingers. His facial expression remains engaged and innocent. (4) The boy briefly hides behind a blue and white patterned blanket before revealing his face again with a wide, joyful grin. A large pink neon heart outline is superimposed around him, and he continues to smile playfully at the viewer.
